title: Knowledge Bank Entry (frontmatter)
description: YAML frontmatter of a knowledge-bank Markdown file. The body below the frontmatter is the retrievable content.

id.description: Unique, stable, kebab-case. Referenced by proposal_plan sources — immutable once used in a run.

tags.description: Retrieval surface. Tags are matched literally, so vocabulary must be consistent across entries.

clearance.description: named: client may be named. anonymised: describe generically, never name. internal-only: excluded from client-facing retrieval.

last_reviewed.description: Entries older than 24 months are flagged stale at retrieval

metrics_verified.description: Must be true for any entry whose body states a number. Unverified metrics must not reach a bid.

section.description: Normally derived from the containing folder; set explicitly only to override

source_document.description: Where the entry's content came from — a past bid deck, a tender response, a methodology document. Set by ingest_source.py and kept, because an entry drafted from a real artifact should be traceable back to it.

bid.description: For past-rfps and presentations entries: what this was bid for and how it went. Outcome is the field that makes the bank worth keeping — reusing language from a lost bid without knowing it lost is worse than writing fresh.

client_ref.description: Client, or an anonymised handle when clearance is not 'named'

outcome.description: Never guess. 'unknown' is a usable value; a wrong 'won' is not.

outcome_notes.description: Scored feedback, debrief points, what the evaluators praised or marked down

sections_that_scored.description: Sections the client's feedback singled out. The highest-value thing a past bid can tell the next one.

supersedes.description: IDs of entries this replaces — retrieval deprioritises superseded entries
